tasks.short: Manage client funds against their investment return

steps.what: Open client funds and their investment return
Manage investments against the return figures
Note where the return does not maximize the brief

tasks.design: Return figures for the client funds are opened on {BI} from {DATA_PLATFORM}. The manager manages the investments. The board does not buy, sell, or decide that the return is the one to maximize. A figure that was not queried is not shown.
tasks.previous_blocker: The return was assembled in a side sheet before the manager could talk about the fund.
tasks.enabler_now: The figures are already in the books, so the board shows them without a side sheet.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the mix, and whether the return is acceptable, stay with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides what the fund holds.
tasks.altitude: The manager sees the stored return before changing the mix.

evidence.claim: A return can be shown from stored figures, and managing the fund stays with the manager. The source pack says investment-fund work barely fits the tools it names, and that a draft may comment only on figures that were queried, with a person signing. A listed figure is not an investment decision.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a human review, and that hiring, appraisal, and staff monitoring need consent. This work does not score staff or investors, and it does not send a trade, a filing, or an offering unless the manager does. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when the manager reviews a client fund and ends when the manager has noted the mix.
A figure has fund id, measure, and date, produced by the books. A measure with no stored value is left blank.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing figure, policy line, or name is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the books are current on the day of the review.
research_questions: Which funds were reviewed with a blank measure?

already_counted.description: The review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is assembling figures the books already hold. The mix and the judgement stay with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select investments and mixes for the fund to purchase

steps.what: Open specific investments on the shortlist
Select investment mixes for the fund
Purchase the investments the manager selected

tasks.design: The shortlist is a list the manager already wrote in {DOCS}. The manager selects the mix and purchases it through {ERP}. Nothing on the shortlist is bought unless the manager selects it. The list is not a ranking of securities.
tasks.previous_blocker: The shortlist lived in notes, and the purchase was phoned through from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: The shortlist is stored against the fund, so the selection starts from named investments.
tasks.still_hard: Which mix to buy, and at what limit, stay the manager's decision.
tasks.human_edge: The manager selects and sends the purchase.
tasks.altitude: The manager sees the shortlist before a purchase is sent.

evidence.claim: A shortlist can be opened, and the selection and the purchase stay with the manager. The source pack says investment-fund work barely fits the tools it names, and that a draft may comment only on figures that were queried, with a person signing. A listed figure is not an investment decision.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a human review, and that hiring, appraisal, and staff monitoring need consent. This work does not score staff or investors, and it does not send a trade, a filing, or an offering unless the manager does. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when the fund is choosing investments and ends when the manager has sent the purchase or stopped.
A shortlist row has fund id and investment id, written by the manager. An id the manager did not write is not on the list.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing figure, policy line, or name is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether the dealer accepts an order that starts from the shortlist.
research_questions: Which shortlisted investments were not selected?

already_counted.description: The review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: purchase the manager selected for that fund

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is opening a shortlist the manager already wrote. Selecting and purchasing stay with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor investment performance against risk goals

steps.what: Monitor performance of the individual investments
Compare financial and operational figures with goals
Ensure the portfolios still meet the risk goals

tasks.design: Performance of each investment is monitored on {BI}. A row is an exception only when its stored measure sits outside a stored limit. The manager ensures the portfolio still meets the risk goal. A row with no limit is shown as unchecked, not as a pass. No person is scored.
tasks.previous_blocker: The check was a side sheet of prices against limits someone had typed.
tasks.enabler_now: The measure and the limit are stored, so the comparison does not need a side sheet.
tasks.still_hard: Whether an exception means the portfolio should change stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides what an exception means for the risk goal.

ambition.what: A portfolio shows its exceptions the morning the books update, and the manager still decides.

tasks.altitude: The manager sees exceptions before the risk conversation.

evidence.claim: A risk check is a stored measure against a stored limit, and the manager decides the consequence. The source pack says investment-fund work barely fits the tools it names, and that a draft may comment only on figures that were queried, with a person signing. A listed figure is not an investment decision.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a human review, and that hiring, appraisal, and staff monitoring need consent. This work does not score staff or investors, and it does not send a trade, a filing, or an offering unless the manager does. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when portfolio figures have been updated and ends when the manager has noted the risk position.
A row has investment id, measure, and limit, produced by the books and the risk policy. A missing limit leaves the row unchecked.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing figure, policy line, or name is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: How many investments have a stored limit on the day of the check.
research_questions: Which investments were unchecked because the limit was missing?

already_counted.description: The review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving counts investments whose measure and limit are both stored. A missing limit is left unchecked, and the risk decision stays with the manager.

tasks.short: Select trades and direct their execution

steps.what: Open the proposed trades for the fund
Select trades and direct their execution
Note trades the manager did not direct

tasks.design: A trade list the manager started is opened in {ERP}. The manager selects the trades and directs execution. A trade is not sent by the system. There is no rule that picks a trade from a price.
tasks.previous_blocker: The order was phoned from a note, and the note was not always the same as the blotter.
tasks.enabler_now: The blotter holds the trade the manager typed, so the call matches the record.
tasks.still_hard: Which trade to send, and at what limit, stay with the manager.
tasks.altitude: The manager sees the trade before it is sent.

evidence.claim: The blotter can hold a trade the manager typed, and the selection and the execution stay with the manager. The source pack says investment-fund work barely fits the tools it names, and that a draft may comment only on figures that were queried, with a person signing. A listed figure is not an investment decision.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect needs a human review, and that hiring, appraisal, and staff monitoring need consent. This work does not score staff or investors, and it does not send a trade, a filing, or an offering unless the manager does. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when the manager is ready to trade and ends when the manager has directed the trade or left it.
A trade row has fund id, investment id, side, and quantity, typed by the manager. A row missing a quantity is not sent.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the manager's effort.
A missing figure, policy line, or name is not invented. The manager does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether the dealer requires a second confirmation beyond this record.
research_questions: Which typed trades were not directed?

already_counted.description: The review time is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: trade the manager selected and directed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is not retyping a trade the manager already entered. Selecting and directing the execution stay with the manager.

role.altitude: Return figures can be shown. The manager selects investments and directs trades. Nothing is bought or sent by a rule.
reach: A client sees the return figures the manager used.
A dealer sees only a trade the manager directed.
skills_to_grow: Do not treat a shown return as a decision to trade.
Do not send a trade the manager did not direct.
role.ambitious_version: Exceptions to a stored risk limit are visible the morning the books update, and the manager still decides.
